meta_skill_content: When editing, treat unchanged binary outcomes as evidence that added wording is not yet effective; avoid duplicating rules or expanding the skill without a concrete failure-to-edit link. Prefer a short call-planning checklist that forces a latest-turn diff against listed cache entries: identify each pending domain, apply only new constraints to its compatible cached result, and bind/save every tool result. Make missing-input handling an explicit per-domain slot check, so blocked hotel searches do not prevent ready restaurant searches and flight dates are not borrowed for hotel stays. Tighten contextual-reply guidance around the specific prior assistant offer/question and the exact action or criterion accepted; do not equate acceptance or a new budget with “no planning needed.” For recurring schema misses, add only canonical, high-confidence mappings (enum labels, state versus city, exact-range encoding) and validate them against tool schemas. Avoid encouraging speculative result rendering or field access; the proximity example still failed on assumed fields. For flight-leg failures, require the call audit to verify every stated leg’s route and departure date rather than adding more explanatory prose.
